svg.title: The picture. And the sound.
svg.desc: Actual v2.3.7 remote-screen controls and sharing bar, captured from the uploaded release build. Sound is off by default and offered only with permission. Clicking Sound plays a Windows PC’s audio alongside the viewer’s own sound. The viewer controls its volume, and the shared PC shows a listening indicator. Wave levels are illustrative sample data, not an audio recording.
svg.text: Hear a Windows PC through its remote screen. Your own sound keeps playing.
The PC shows when you listen.
VIEWER CONTROLS / ACTUAL V2.3.7 UI — ENLARGED
SHARING BAR / THE LISTENING INDICATOR — ENLARGED
Off by default. Allow listening on the Remote page first. Windows PCs share sound; Macs can listen.
Actual release UI with sample connections. The waveform is illustrative.
